SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF APR-28-2015 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF APR-28-2015 BY JUDGE PRO TEM JEAN MILEFF. THE PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. THE TWO DEFENDANTS WERE PRESENT. BOTH THE PLAINTIFF AND THE DEFENDANTS FILE STIPULATION TO HAVE A JUDGE PRO TEM. THE DEFENDANT IS IS ASSISTED BY INTERPRETER, LORRAINE WONG IN THE CANTONESE LANGUAGE. INTERPRETER IS ADMINISTERED THE INTERPRETER'S OATH. DEFENDANT'S WITNESSES AARON THACH, LORRAINE WONG AND CASPER LEUNG WERE SWORN. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM JEAN MILEFF, CLERK KEVIN LEE, NOT ON THE RECORD, D506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-28-2015 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KU, ALEX RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT WONG, TIM WONG, LINDA $357.00 PRINCIPAL, $60.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $417.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
